title: Aga-t “Mini-Genesis”
description: This project was my very first journey into the world of design, with the kind designers at Captivape taking me through the design process from drafting to manufacturing at the age of 16. This was early in the era of “mods,” when most e-cigs were designed and built by turning blanks in garages. I saw a problem with how efficient the genesis systems were at that time, so I decided to design the first reduced-chamber “mini-genesis,” built from community feedback and manufactured here in the USA.
